title: Delegation worktree reclaim retains every non-worker isolated worktree seeded from a dirty parent
outcome: A non-worker isolated delegation whose worktree holds only the parent's seeded staged/unstaged state, unchanged by the child, is reclaimed when it ends like a clean worktree, instead of being retained forever with a note asking the parent to integrate its own state.
acceptance: Delegation worktree reclaim retains every non-worker isolated worktree seeded from a dirty parent is done
